book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Luka aime Iesu

content: Amarikong Pilato Iesu
Are ratmat ga mirier ganam la temaiara ga alagimeng Iesu me ai Pilato.

Pumiaro la maiabua na ties ga megama, “Avop iriro migana la afulutong tavuk maiang garip ma teip ga magaulap pam. Ga pabunakong meba tale palang takis aun orong Kaisar onim Rom. Ga ume ties gare ro, ‘Turuo kan Karisito. Turuo orong.’”
Pa amarikong Pilato, “Nunuo Orong maiang garip onim Israel, a?” Pa upulo Iesu ties ang, gare ro, “Nunuo kan la tiesnung gare tie.”
Tie maulo Pilato miridaip mila kakanim ga inamaniap, “Tale kan orup kiribas ba ira iriro migana.”
Pa tiesmeng maranit kan, gare ro, “Masinguala teip ga magaulap ga ofulutong agat maiong na mirier napup na provins Iudaia. Puaro na provins Galili ga akosarong iriro tavuk ga muo puoong togo.”
Amarikong Herot Iesu
Urie, upto Pilato uriro ties, ga mamarikong, “Iriro migana irie migana onim Galili, a?”
Pa megama, “Eva, Iesu irie migana onim na uriro provins la uale Herot ubuo.” Are ratmat ga asagaong Pilato ga ula ai Herot. Na iriro tara Herot gat la unama Ierusalem.
Agimaong Herot Iesu, ga mitara teuba. Upto ties aime, ga mitara laklage tara la namo agimaang. Namo agimaang Iesu le akosarang paga ba o turupnuabap.
Are ratmat ga amarikong Herot Iesu ma papot ma pagap. Pa tale kan upulo Iesu ties ang.
Pa miridaip mila kakanim ga teip la omeit maimai la mumaio dusmeng kagarat ga man avuremeng o ties ula mamaranu.
Ga Herot ga teip am o danunumiap la apukemeng Iesu ga fugaumeng ira a. Ga maiara non sasa ila mumuri ga mena ira a are orong. Ga inagat asagameng ga ula ai Pilato.
Tinan Herot ga Pilato la lime nekarolila. Pa titot na iriro tara la nemiganliong bat.
Pilato la tiesong meba menamung Iesu ga aving
Urie, inagat mumaio maiala Iesu aun Pilato ga mamarikong Pilato miridaip mila kakanim ga teip mila uke onim Iudaia ga inamaniap ga mumaio nebolameng.

Ga maulo, “Alagiming iriro migana ga muo toi, ga migama, ‘Man afulutong tavuk maiang teip ga magaulap. Pa agattung iro migana la tale kan orup kiribas ba ira a me miriro pagap la miabua na ties maime.
Herot gat la aret tie ga ina asagaong ga muo bui. Miptang, iriro migana la tale kan okosarong kiribas ba meba puoieng le bunamung ga aving.
Are ratmat ga ebat aisiktang ga tairang meba ala.” [
Pamaning iriro tavuk: O la ula aipieng mar mirie karaip, Pilato la ume avik non migana la unama na luguan o arubu ga ula agarit mai Iudaiap.]
Tie, teip ga magaulap ganam la iat marikmeng maranit gare ro, “Teanamung iriro migana ga aving pa tevikang Barabas ga muong pai.”
Barabas la puaro non danunumiap ira non gar ang gavaman tapma na taun ga unamuam non teip ga mevara, ga maiabua na luguan o arubu.
Tie, Pilato la ina tiesong maime gat. Namo avikang Iesu ga ala.
Pa marikmeng maranit, “Tesopang iro maiogun! Tesopang iro maiogun!”

Tie, lama naien tara, Pilato la ina gat mamarikong, “Memani? Iriro migana la okosarong man kiribas, a? Tale kan orup kiribas ba ira a la puoieng meba bunamung ga aving. Are ratmat ga eba aisiktang ga tairang meba ala.”
Pa mitara mamaranim, ga inagat amarikmeng maranit meba tesopang Iesu iro maiogun. Ga kupkup maiong la okurupin ties ang Pilato.
Are ratmat ga ouluan Pilato ties maiong.

Teip ga magaulap la amarikmeng meba ina alagimeng iriro migana Barabas. Ga avikong Pilato ga ula mai. Ga ouluan agat maiong gar onim Israel ga uala Iesu na kilalap ma teip am o danunumiap meba menamung ga aving.
Teip o danunumiap la asapmeng Iesu iro maiogun

Urie, na tara la merana teip o danunumiap onim Rom Iesu ga ula, tie umaiat a non migana, bonim a Simon onim na taun Sairini. Titot it la mauo na pianam ang ga namo ala Ierusalem. Pa maiabu maiogun bo barana a, ga uavio ga auluan Iesu.
Pa gar ila kakani ma teip ga magaulap la ameuluan ga mela. Ga papaluaip ma magaulap kabirana ma la man meliba maranit aime.
Pa terigiong Iesu ga maulo, “Mimi magaulap onim Ierusalem, buat miliba me rulam. Temaieng le miliba kan me milam ga me lop mim.

Memani, miptang! Tubiat a noba tara leba betang teip ga magaulap tapmat eba memama, ‘Magaulap la tale kan puomeng meba lopmaiaring, ga magaulap la tale kan maiariam lop, ga magaulap la tale masisimeng lop, mirie eba temeba migat.’
Na irie tara leba mamelava kavilap ga memama, ‘Milaming pabuo!’ Ga eba mamelava tatak pugulap, ‘Pamimung!’
Leba betmeng miriro giginanimup ira ma inamaniap mila puvuvum ga makirarameng, pa na tara miriro giginanimup leba betmeng ira ma inamaniap mila kiram eba makirarameng kan maset.”
Urie, maialan gat non narain teipien, teipien lila okosarong kirinim. Namo menamungan iat ga Iesu.

Mela betmeng na non pianam, bonim o Muanam o bugam. Na uriro pianam la asapmeng Iesu iro maiogun. Ga lesapmeng gat non narain teipien lila kiran. Irie la sapong na kilan ila lamige a Iesu, pa irie na kilan ila kaiarong.
Urie, ugama Iesu, “Mamo, navaiang kirinim maiong. Memani, tale ameit iriro paga la akosarmeng.” Pa teip o danunumiap la sagumeng o satu meba mavuotmeng burap am Iesu me ira ma kan.

Pa teip ga magaulap la dusmeng ga man umei. Pa teip mila uke onim Israel la fugaumeng ira Iesu gare ro, “Agimaming! Ume maagaulie non teip ga magaulap. Pa leba migat ba Morowa, la avuoong meba okosarang ubi ang, eba ina malagiang teip ga magaulap am tie teairang ga irie kan le teagaalie!”
Teip o danunumiap gat la fugaumeng ira Iesu. Mumaio kagarat ai ga namo maialang viniga aun meba meiniang maset bonim a me lourup.
Ga megama, “Leba migat ba nunuo orong maiang garip onim Iudaia, tie teaganalie kan!”
Pa ame non gat umir la iot iro maiogun nakap bo bugam a Iesu. Uriro umir la igama, “Iriro migana la irie orong maiang Iudaiap.”
Urie, litiro teipien o pula la sapliong, irie la fugauong ira Iesu ga ugama, “Nunuo Karisito, a? Tie, teaganalie ga iaganalie gat.”
Pa irie la upto uriro ga abukula ga ugama, “Nunuo la nuavio kan giginanim gare iriro migana na ties, ga tale nurau aime Morowa, a?
Teip o danunumiap leba bimenamung ga bivara, tie iriro tavuk la puvuvui irama, memani bibi la okosarbing kirinim ga puoieng meba biving. Pa iriro migana la tale kan okosarong kirinim ba.”
Urie, aulo ga ugama, “Iesu, tubiat na tara leba betnang orong na inamon nung, tie, toagatnang.”
Pa aulo Iesu gare ro, “Norulo migat: Titot eba nonang ga turuo na inamon tung.”
Iesu la uvara ra
Urie, titot tara la betong gare 12 o muabari, ga arubu la ialu kimanam gano ga ila puoieng na 3 o muabari nabit.
Ga arubu la ialu muabari ga irie buruma ila kakani la sapong na luguan ila babai o lotu, la giritong gane ga narain napupien a.
Tie, Iesu la kukupong maranit ga ugama, “Mamo, tuabua muranama ruo na kilan nuo!” Tiesong gare tiro ga uvara.
Migana ila uke me 100 ma teip o danunumiap onim Rom la agimaong man paga la betong, ga avienong Morowa me nakap. Ugama, “migat ara, iriro migana la irie migana ila puvuvui.”

Ga mirier teip ga magaulap ganam la mumaio nebolameng, ga man magimameng pagap la betmeng ga mitara kadikmeng, ga masakmeng arop ma meba masingmaiala mirie non la giginam dalap ma migat. Okosarsarmeng gare tiro ga ina mela na luguap maiam.
Pa mirier inamaniap la ameit maset Iesu ga magaulap la temaiara na provins Galili ga ameuluan Iesu ga mumaio, dusmeng kakaliat tarot ga man magimameng miriro pagap ganam la betmeng.
Maiabua tongan Iesu na lu a tadas

Urie, non migana la unama bonim a Iosep. Irie onim Aramatia, non taun na provins Iudaia irie migana ila muri ga puvuvui. Irie gat non migana ma kaunselip mila uke, pa tale kan naong me agat ga tavuk maiang non kaunselip. Pa ume uanula meba ogimaang inamon ang Morowa.
Iriro migana la ula ai Pilato ga amarikong a tongan Iesu.
Pilato la keula me Iosep ga uara Iosep tongan Iesu ga muo lourup iro maiogun, ga ualua a non buruma ila pasokong ga uabua tapma na lu a tadas. Pa tinan la tale ka memua migana ba ana.
Uriro la la lama gunamur la Fraide. La o uranga ma pagap me uriro la o sabat la namo ra betieng.
Magaulap la temaiara Galili ga mumaio ga Iesu, ameuluan Iosep ga mela. Ga agimameng iriro una ga agimameng gat Iosep la ugamani ga uabua tongan Iesu.
Agimameng ara ga inar mela na luguap maiam. Ga marangameng kuop ga pagap la ame kukuf ula mumuru meba maiabum ira tongan Iesu. Pa na la o sabat la agamelie are maimai ang Moses la ilo.
